049    public static final IrBoolVar False = new IrBoolVar(false);

051    public static IrBoolVar constant(boolean value) {
052        return value ? True : False;

055    public static IrBoolVar bool(String name) {

059    public static IrBoolExpr not(IrBoolExpr proposition) {
060        if (proposition.isConstant()) {
061            // Reverse the boolean
062            return proposition.getDomain().isTrue() ? False : True;
063        }
064        return proposition.negate();
065    }

067    public static IrBoolExpr and(Collection<? extends IrBoolExpr> operands) {
068        return and(operands.toArray(new IrBoolExpr[operands.size()]));
069    }
070
071    public static IrBoolExpr and(IrBoolExpr... operands) {
072        List<IrBoolExpr> flatten = new ArrayList<>(operands.length);
073        for (IrBoolExpr operand : operands) {
074            if (operand instanceof IrAnd) {
075                // Invariant: No nested IrAnd
076                flatten.addAll(Arrays.asList(((IrAnd) operand).getOperands()));
077            } else {
078                flatten.add(operand);
079            }
080        }
081        List<IrBoolExpr> filter = new ArrayList<>(flatten.size());
082        for (IrBoolExpr operand : flatten) {
083            if (operand.getDomain().isFalse()) {
084                return False;
085            }
086            if (!operand.getDomain().isTrue()) {
087                filter.add(operand);
088            }
089        }
090        switch (filter.size()) {
091            case 0:
092                return True;
093            case 1:
094                return filter.get(0);
095            default:
096                return new IrAnd(filter.toArray(new IrBoolExpr[filter.size()]), TrueFalseDomain);
097        }
098    }

100    public static IrBoolExpr lone(Collection<? extends IrBoolExpr> operands) {

102    }

104    public static IrBoolExpr lone(IrBoolExpr... operands) {
105        List<IrBoolExpr> filter = new ArrayList<>(operands.length);
106        int count = 0;
107        for (IrBoolExpr operand : operands) {
108            if (operand.getDomain().isTrue()) {
109                count++;
110                if (count > 1) {
111                    return False;
112                }
113            } else if (!operand.getDomain().isFalse()) {
114                filter.add(operand);
115            }
116        }
117        assert count == 0 || count == 1;
118        switch (filter.size()) {
119            case 0:
120                return True;
121            case 1:
122                return count == 0 ? True : not(filter.get(0));
123            default:
124                IrBoolExpr[] f = filter.toArray(new IrBoolExpr[filter.size()]);
125                return count == 0
126                        ? new IrLone(f, TrueFalseDomain)
127                        : not(or(f));
128        }
129    }

131    public static IrBoolExpr one(Collection<? extends IrBoolExpr> operands) {
132        return one(operands.toArray(new IrBoolExpr[operands.size()]));
133    }

135    public static IrBoolExpr one(IrBoolExpr... operands) {
136        List<IrBoolExpr> filter = new ArrayList<>(operands.length);
137        int count = 0;
138        for (IrBoolExpr operand : operands) {
139            if (operand.getDomain().isTrue()) {
140                count++;
141                if (count > 1) {
142                    return False;
143                }
144            } else if (!operand.getDomain().isFalse()) {
145                filter.add(operand);
146            }
147        }
148        assert count == 0 || count == 1;
149        switch (filter.size()) {
150            case 0:
151                return count == 0 ? False : True;
152            case 1:
153                return count == 0 ? filter.get(0) : not(filter.get(0));
154            case 2:
155                return count == 0
156                        ? xor(filter.get(0), filter.get(1))
157                        : and(not(filter.get(0)), not(filter.get(1)));
158            default:
159                IrBoolExpr[] f = filter.toArray(new IrBoolExpr[filter.size()]);
160                return count == 0
161                        ? new IrOne(f, TrueFalseDomain)
162                        : not(or(f));
163        }
164    }

166    public static IrBoolExpr or(Collection<? extends IrBoolExpr> operands) {
167        return or(operands.toArray(new IrBoolExpr[operands.size()]));
168    }

170    public static IrBoolExpr or(IrBoolExpr... operands) {
171        List<IrBoolExpr> flatten = new ArrayList<>(operands.length);
172        for (IrBoolExpr operand : operands) {
173            if (operand instanceof IrOr) {
174                // Invariant: No nested IrOr
175                flatten.addAll(Arrays.asList(((IrOr) operand).getOperands()));
176            } else {
177                flatten.add(operand);
178            }
179        }
180        List<IrBoolExpr> filter = new ArrayList<>(flatten.size());
181        for (IrBoolExpr operand : flatten) {
182            if (operand.getDomain().isTrue()) {
183                return True;
184            }
185            if (!operand.getDomain().isFalse()) {
186                filter.add(operand);
187            }
188        }
189        switch (filter.size()) {
190            case 0:
191                return False;
192            case 1:
193                return filter.get(0);
194            default:
195                return new IrOr(filter.toArray(new IrBoolExpr[filter.size()]), TrueFalseDomain);
196        }
197    }

199    public static IrBoolExpr implies(IrBoolExpr antecedent, IrBoolExpr consequent) {
200        return or(not(antecedent), consequent);
201    }
202
203    public static IrBoolExpr ifThenElse(IrBoolExpr antecedent, IrBoolExpr consequent, IrBoolExpr alternative) {
204        if (antecedent.getDomain().isTrue()) {
205            return consequent;
206        }
207        if (antecedent.getDomain().isFalse()) {
208            return alternative;
209        }
210        if (consequent.getDomain().isTrue()) {
211            return or(antecedent, alternative);
212        }
213        if (consequent.getDomain().isFalse()) {
214            return and(antecedent.negate(), alternative);
215        }
216        if (alternative.getDomain().isTrue()) {
217            return or(antecedent.negate(), consequent);
218        }
219        if (alternative.getDomain().isFalse()) {
220            return and(antecedent, consequent);
221        }
222        return new IrIfThenElse(antecedent, consequent, alternative, TrueFalseDomain);
223    }
224
225    public static IrBoolExpr ifOnlyIf(IrBoolExpr left, IrBoolExpr right) {
226        if (left.equals(right)) {
227            return True;
228        }
229        if (left.getDomain().isTrue()) {
230            return right;
231        }
232        if (left.getDomain().isFalse()) {
233            return not(right);
234        }
235        if (right.getDomain().isTrue()) {
236            return left;
237        }
238        if (right.getDomain().isFalse()) {
239            return not(left);
240        }
241        if (left.isNegative() && right.isNegative()) {
242            return new IrIfOnlyIf(left.negate(), right.negate(), TrueFalseDomain);
243        }
244        return new IrIfOnlyIf(left, right, TrueFalseDomain);
245    }
246
247    public static IrBoolExpr xor(IrBoolExpr left, IrBoolExpr right) {
248        if (left.getDomain().isTrue()) {
249            return not(right);
250        }
251        if (left.getDomain().isFalse()) {
252            return right;
253        }
254        if (right.getDomain().isTrue()) {
255            return not(left);
256        }
257        if (right.getDomain().isFalse()) {
258            return left;
259        }
260        if (left.isNegative()) {
261            return ifOnlyIf(left.negate(), right);
262        }
263        if (right.isNegative()) {
264            return ifOnlyIf(left, right.negate());
265        }
266        return new IrIfOnlyIf(left, right.negate(), TrueFalseDomain);
267    }

277    public static IrBoolExpr compare(IrIntExpr left, IrCompare.Op op, IrIntExpr right) {
278        Domain leftDomain = left.getDomain();
279        Domain rightDomain = right.getDomain();
280        switch (op) {
281            case Equal:
282                if (left.equals(right)) {
283                    return True;
284                }
285                if (!leftDomain.intersects(rightDomain)) {
286                    return False;
287                }
288                if (left instanceof IrBoolExpr && right instanceof IrBoolExpr) {
289                    return ifOnlyIf((IrBoolExpr) left, (IrBoolExpr) right);
290                }
291                break;
292            case NotEqual:
293                if (left.equals(right)) {
294                    return False;
295                }
296                if (!leftDomain.intersects(rightDomain)) {
297                    return True;
298                }
299                if (left instanceof IrBoolExpr && right instanceof IrBoolExpr) {
300                    return xor((IrBoolExpr) left, (IrBoolExpr) right);
301                }
302                break;
303            case LessThanEqual:
304                if (left.equals(right)) {
305                    return True;
306                }
307                if (leftDomain.getHighBound() <= rightDomain.getLowBound()) {
308                    return True;
309                }
310                if (leftDomain.getLowBound() > rightDomain.getHighBound()) {
311                    return False;
312                }
313                if (leftDomain.getLowBound() == rightDomain.getHighBound()) {
314                    return equal(left, right);
315                }
316                if (left instanceof IrBoolExpr && right instanceof IrBoolExpr) {
317                    return implies((IrBoolExpr) left, (IrBoolExpr) right);
318                }
319                if (left instanceof IrMinus && right instanceof IrMinus) {
320                    return greaterThanEqual(((IrMinus) left).getExpr(), ((IrMinus) right).getExpr());
321                }
322                break;
323            default:
324                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown op: " + op);
325        }
326        return new IrCompare(left, op, right, TrueFalseDomain);
327    }
328
329    public static IrBoolExpr compare(IrStringExpr left, IrStringCompare.Op op, IrStringExpr right) {
330        if (left.equals(right)) {
331            switch (op) {
332                case Equal:
333                case LessThanEqual:
334                    return True;
335                case NotEqual:
336                case LessThan:
337                    return False;
338                default:
339                    throw new IllegalArgumentException();
340            }
341        }
342        if (!left.getLength().intersects(right.getLength())) {
343            switch (op) {
344                case Equal:
345                    return False;
346                case NotEqual:
347                    return True;
348            }
349        }
350        int minLength = Math.min(left.getLength().getLowBound(), right.getLength().getLowBound());
351        for (int i = 0; i < minLength; i++) {
352            if (!left.getChars()[i].intersects(right.getChars()[i])) {
353                switch (op) {
354                    case Equal:
355                        return False;
356                    case NotEqual:
357                        return True;
358                }
359            }
360        }
361        return new IrStringCompare(left, op, right, TrueFalseDomain);
362    }

387    public static IrBoolExpr equality(IrIntArrayExpr left, IrArrayEquality.Op op, IrIntArrayExpr right) {
388        if (op.equals(IrArrayEquality.Op.Equal) && left instanceof IrIntArrayVar && right instanceof IrIntArrayVar) {
389            return equal((IrIntArrayVar) left, (IrIntArrayVar) right);
390        }
391        if (left.length() != right.length()) {
392            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
393        }
394        for (int i = 0; i < left.length(); i++) {
395            if (!left.getDomains()[i].intersects(right.getDomains()[i])) {
396                switch (op) {
397                    case Equal:
398                        return False;
399                    case NotEqual:
400                        return True;
401                }
402            }
403        }
404        return new IrArrayEquality(left, op, right, TrueFalseDomain);
405    }
406
407    public static IrBoolExpr equal(IrIntArrayVar left, IrIntArrayVar right) {
408        if (left.length() != right.length()) {
409            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
410        }
411        List<IrIntExpr> filterLeft = new ArrayList<>(left.length());
412        List<IrIntExpr> filterRight = new ArrayList<>(right.length());
413        for (int i = 0; i < left.length(); i++) {
414            if (!left.getDomains()[i].intersects(right.getDomains()[i])) {
415                return False;
416            }
417            if (!left.getArray()[i].equals(right.getArray()[i])) {
418                filterLeft.add(left.getArray()[i]);
419                filterRight.add(right.getArray()[i]);
420            }
421        }
422        if (filterLeft.isEmpty()) {
423            return True;
424        }
425        if (filterLeft.size() == 1) {
426            return equal(filterLeft.get(0), filterRight.get(0));
427        }
428        if (filterLeft.size() == left.length()) {
429            return new IrArrayEquality(left, IrArrayEquality.Op.Equal, right, TrueFalseDomain);
430        }
431        return new IrArrayEquality(
432                array(filterLeft.toArray(new IrIntExpr[filterLeft.size()])),
433                IrArrayEquality.Op.Equal,
434                array(filterRight.toArray(new IrIntExpr[filterRight.size()])),
435                TrueFalseDomain);
436    }

438    public static IrBoolExpr equal(IrIntArrayExpr left, IrIntArrayExpr right) {
439        return equality(left, IrArrayEquality.Op.Equal, right);
440    }

442    public static IrBoolExpr equality(IrSetExpr left, IrSetEquality.Op op, IrSetExpr right) {
443        switch (op) {
444            case Equal:
445                if (left.equals(right)) {
446                    return True;
447                }
448                if (!left.getKer().isSubsetOf(right.getEnv())
449                        || !right.getKer().isSubsetOf(left.getEnv())) {
450                    return False;
451                }
452                if (!left.getCard().intersects(right.getCard())) {
453                    return False;
454                }
455                if (left.isConstant()) {
456                    Domain constant = left.getKer();
457                    /*
458                     * The idea is that integer constraints are easier to
459                     * optimize than set constraints. If the expression is a top
460                     * level expression than the cardinality propagator will
461                     * optimize this expression away anyways.
462                     */
463                    if (constant.isEmpty()) {
464                        return equal(card(right), 0);
465                    }
466                    if (constant.size() == right.getEnv().size()) {
467                        return constant.isSubsetOf(right.getEnv())
468                                ? equal(card(right), constant.size()) : False;
469                    }
470                }
471                if (right.isConstant()) {
472                    Domain constant = right.getKer();
473                    if (constant.isEmpty()) {
474                        return equal(card(left), 0);
475                    }
476                    if (constant.size() == left.getEnv().size()) {
477                        return constant.isSubsetOf(left.getEnv())
478                                ? equal(card(left), constant.size()) : False;
479                    }
480                }
481                IrIntExpr leftInt = IrUtil.asInt(left);
482                if (leftInt != null) {
483                    IrIntExpr rightInt = IrUtil.asInt(right);
484                    if (rightInt != null) {
485                        return equal(leftInt, rightInt);
486                    }
487                }
488                break;
489            case NotEqual:
490                if (left.equals(right)) {
491                    return False;
492                }
493                if (!left.getKer().isSubsetOf(right.getEnv())
494                        || !right.getKer().isSubsetOf(left.getEnv())) {
495                    return True;
496                }
497                if (!left.getCard().intersects(right.getCard())) {
498                    return True;
499                }
500                if (left.isConstant()) {
501                    Domain constant = left.getKer();
502                    if (constant.isEmpty()) {
503                        return notEqual(card(right), 0);
504                    }
505                    if (constant.size() == right.getEnv().size()) {
506                        return constant.isSubsetOf(right.getEnv())
507                                ? notEqual(card(right), constant.size()) : True;
508                    }
509                }
510                if (right.isConstant()) {
511                    Domain constant = right.getKer();
512                    if (constant.isEmpty()) {
513                        return notEqual(card(left), 0);
514                    }
515                    if (constant.size() == left.getEnv().size()) {
516                        return constant.isSubsetOf(left.getEnv())
517                                ? notEqual(card(left), constant.size()) : True;
518                    }
519                }
520                leftInt = IrUtil.asInt(left);
521                if (leftInt != null) {
522                    IrIntExpr rightInt = IrUtil.asInt(right);
523                    if (rightInt != null) {
524                        return notEqual(leftInt, rightInt);
525                    }
526                }
527                break;
528            default:
529                throw new IllegalArgumentException();
530        }
531        return new IrSetEquality(left, op, right, TrueFalseDomain);
532    }

628    public static IrBoolExpr member(IrIntExpr element, IrSetExpr set) {
629        if (element.getDomain().isSubsetOf(set.getKer())) {
630            return True;
631        } else if (!element.getDomain().intersects(set.getEnv())) {
632            return False;
633        } else if (set.getEnv().isConstant()) {
634            if (element.isConstant()) {
635                return equal(card(set), 1);
636            } else if (set.isConstant()) {
637                return equal(element, set.getEnv().getLowBound());
638            }
639        } else if (set.isConstant()) {
640            Domain diff = element.getDomain().difference(set.getKer());
641            switch (diff.size()) {
642                case 0:
643                    return True;
644                case 1:
645                    return notEqual(element, diff.getLowBound());
646            }
647        }
648        return new IrMember(element, set, TrueFalseDomain);
649    }
650
651    public static IrBoolExpr notMember(IrIntExpr element, IrSetExpr set) {
652        if (!element.getDomain().intersects(set.getEnv())) {
653            return True;
654        } else if (element.getDomain().isSubsetOf(set.getKer())) {
655            return False;
656        } else if (set.getEnv().isConstant()) {
657            if (element.isConstant()) {
658                return equal(card(set), 0);
659            } else if (set.isConstant()) {
660                return notEqual(element, set.getEnv().getLowBound());
661            }
662        } else if (set.isConstant()) {
663            Domain diff = element.getDomain().difference(set.getKer());
664            switch (diff.size()) {
665                case 0:
666                    return False;
667                case 1:
668                    return equal(element, diff.getLowBound());
669            }
670        }
671        return new IrNotMember(element, set, TrueFalseDomain);
672    }

674    public static IrBoolExpr subsetEq(IrSetExpr subset, IrSetExpr superset) {
675        if (subset.getEnv().isSubsetOf(superset.getKer())) {
676            return True;
677        }
678        if (subset.getCard().getLowBound() == superset.getCard().getHighBound()) {
679            return equal(subset, superset);
680        }
681        return new IrSubsetEq(subset, superset, TrueFalseDomain);
682    }

684    public static IrBoolExpr boolChannel(IrBoolExpr[] bools, IrSetExpr set) {
685        if (set.getEnv().isEmpty()
686                || (set.getEnv().getLowBound() >= 0 && set.getEnv().getHighBound() < bools.length)) {
687            if (set.isConstant()) {
688                IrBoolExpr[] ands = new IrBoolExpr[bools.length];
689                for (int i = 0; i < ands.length; i++) {
690                    ands[i] = equal(bools[i], set.getKer().contains(i) ? True : False);
691                }
692                return and(ands);
693            }
694            if (bools.length == 1) {
695                return equal(bools[0], card(set));
696            }
697            TIntHashSet values = new TIntHashSet();
698            Domain env = set.getEnv();
699            Domain ker = set.getKer();
700            boolean entailed = true;
701            for (int i = 0; i < bools.length; i++) {
702                if (bools[i].getDomain().isTrue()) {
703                    if (values != null) {
704                        values.add(i);
705                    }
706                    if (!env.contains(i)) {
707                        return False;
708                    }
709                    if (!ker.contains(i)) {
710                        entailed = false;
711                    }
712                } else if (bools[i].getDomain().isFalse()) {
713                    if (ker.contains(i)) {
714                        return False;
715                    }
716                    if (env.contains(i)) {
717                        entailed = false;
718                    }
719                } else {
720                    values = null;
721                    entailed = false;
722                }
723            }
724            if (entailed) {
725                return True;
726            }
727            if (values != null) {
728                return equal(set, constant(enumDomain(values)));
729            }
730        }
731        return new IrBoolChannel(bools, set, TrueFalseDomain);
732    }
733
734    public static IrBoolExpr intChannel(IrIntExpr[] ints, IrSetExpr[] sets) {
735        if (ints.length == 0) {
736            IrBoolExpr[] empty = new IrBoolExpr[sets.length];
737            for (int i = 0; i < empty.length; i++) {
738                empty[i] = equal(sets[i], EmptySet);
739            }
740            return and(empty);
741        }
742        if (sets.length == 0) {
743            return ints.length == 0 ? True : False;
744        }
745        boolean entailed = true;
746        for (int i = 0; i < ints.length; i++) {
747            if (ints[i].isConstant()) {
748                int constant = ints[i].getLowBound();
749                if (constant < 0 || constant >= sets.length) {
750                    return False;
751                }
752                IrSetExpr set = sets[constant];
753                if (!set.getEnv().contains(i)) {
754                    return False;
755                } else if (!set.getKer().contains(i)) {
756                    entailed = false;
757                }
758            } else {
759                entailed = false;
760            }
761        }
762        for (int i = 0; i < sets.length; i++) {
763            if (sets[i].isConstant()) {
764                PrimitiveIterator.OfInt iter = sets[i].getKer().iterator();
765                while (iter.hasNext()) {
766                    int j = iter.next();
767                    if (j < 0 || j >= ints.length) {
768                        return False;
769                    }
770                    IrIntExpr iexpr = ints[j];
771                    if (!iexpr.getDomain().contains(i)) {
772                        return False;
773                    } else if (iexpr.getDomain().size() != 1) {
774                        entailed = false;
775                    }
776                }
777            } else {
778                entailed = false;
779            }
780        }
781        if (entailed) {
782            return True;
783        }
784        return new IrIntChannel(ints, sets, TrueFalseDomain);
785    }

792        for (int i = 0; i < array.length - 1; i++) {
793            sort[i] = lessThanEqual(array[i], array[i + 1]);
794        }
795        return and(sort);

809    public static IrBoolExpr sort(IrSetExpr[] sets, IrIntExpr[] bounds) {
810        if (sets.length != bounds.length) {
811            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
812        }
813        if (sets.length == 0) {
814            return True;
815        }
816        if (bounds.length == 1 || bounds[bounds.length - 2].isConstant()) {
817            int low = bounds.length == 1 ? 0 : bounds[bounds.length - 2].getLowBound();
818            if (bounds[bounds.length - 1].isConstant()) {
819                int high = bounds[bounds.length - 1].getLowBound();
820                Domain bound = fromToDomain(low, high);
821
822                IrSetExpr[] filterSets = Arrays.copyOf(sets, sets.length - 1);
823                IrIntExpr[] filterBounds = Arrays.copyOf(bounds, bounds.length - 1);
824                return and(equal(sets[sets.length - 1], constant(bound)), sort(filterSets, filterBounds));
825            }
826        }
827        // TODO optimize
828        return new IrSortSets(sets, bounds, TrueFalseDomain);
829    }

831    private static IrBoolExpr sortStrings(IrIntExpr[][] strings, boolean strict) {
832        if (strings.length < 2) {
833            return True;
834        }
835
836        boolean[] filter = new boolean[strings.length];
837        for (int i = 0; i < strings.length - 1; i++) {
838            if (strict) {
839                switch (IrUtil.compareString(strings[i], strings[i + 1])) {
840                    case LT:
841                        break;
842                    case GT:
843                    case GE:
844                    case EQ:
845                        return False;
846                    default:
847                        filter[i] = true;
848                        filter[i + 1] = true;
849                }
850            } else {
851                switch (IrUtil.compareString(strings[i], strings[i + 1])) {
852                    case LT:
853                        break;
854                    case GT:
855                        return False;
856                    default:
857                        filter[i] = true;
858                        filter[i + 1] = true;
859                }
860            }
861        }
862        List<IrIntExpr[]> filterStrings = new ArrayList<>(strings.length);
863        for (int i = 0; i < filter.length; i++) {
864            if (filter[i]) {
865                filterStrings.add(strings[i]);
866            }
867        }
868        if (filterStrings.size() != strings.length) {
869            return sortStrings(filterStrings.toArray(new IrIntExpr[filterStrings.size()][]), strict);
870        }
871
872        int minLength = strings[0].length;
873        for (int i = 1; i < strings.length; i++) {
874            minLength = Math.min(minLength, strings[i].length);
875        }
876        for (int i = 0; i < minLength; i++) {
877            boolean allSame = true;
878            for (int j = 0; allSame && j < strings.length - 1; j++) {
879                allSame &= strings[j][i].equals(strings[j + 1][i]);
880            }
881            if (allSame) {
882                IrIntExpr[][] reducedString = new IrIntExpr[strings.length][];
883                for (int k = 0; k < reducedString.length; k++) {
884                    reducedString[k] = new IrIntExpr[strings[k].length - 1];
885                    System.arraycopy(strings[k], 0, reducedString[k], 0, i);
886                    for (int l = i + 1; l < strings[k].length; l++) {
887                        reducedString[k][l - 1] = strings[k][l];
888                    }
889                }
890                return sortStrings(reducedString, strict);
891            }
892        }
893
894        if (minLength == 0) {
895            return strict ? False : True;
896        }
897        if (minLength == 1) {
898            IrIntExpr[] array = new IrIntExpr[strings.length];
899            for (int i = 0; i < strings.length; i++) {
900                IrIntExpr[] string = strings[i];
901                if (string.length != 1) {
902                    return new IrSortStrings(strings, strict, TrueFalseDomain);
903                }
904                array[i] = strings[i][0];
905            }
906            return strict ? sortStrict(array) : sort(array);
907        }
908        return new IrSortStrings(strings, strict, TrueFalseDomain);
909    }

919    public static IrBoolExpr sortChannel(IrIntExpr[][] strings, IrIntExpr[] ints) {
920        if (strings.length != ints.length) {
921            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
922        }
923        for (int i = 1; i < strings.length; i++) {
924            if (strings[0].length != strings[i].length) {
925                throw new IllegalArgumentException();
926            }
927        }
928        List<IrIntExpr[]> filterStrings = new ArrayList<>(strings.length);
929        List<IrIntExpr> filterInts = new ArrayList<>(ints.length);
930        for (int i = 0; i < ints.length; i++) {
931            boolean equivalence = false;
932            for (int j = i + 1; j < ints.length; j++) {
933                if (IrUtil.Ordering.EQ.equals(IrUtil.compare(ints[i], ints[j]))
934                        && IrUtil.Ordering.EQ.equals(IrUtil.compareString(strings[i], strings[j]))) {
935                    equivalence = true;
936                    break;
937                }
938            }
939            if (!equivalence) {
940                filterStrings.add(strings[i]);
941                filterInts.add(ints[i]);
942            }
943        }
944        assert !filterInts.isEmpty();
945        if (filterInts.size() == 1) {
946            return equal(filterInts.get(0), 0);
947        }
948        IrIntExpr[][] fstrings = filterStrings.toArray(new IrIntExpr[filterStrings.size()][]);
949        IrIntExpr[] fints = filterInts.toArray(new IrIntExpr[filterInts.size()]);
950        int[] constant = IrUtil.getConstant(fints);
951        if (constant != null) {
952            IrIntExpr[][] partialOrdering = new IrIntExpr[constant.length][];
953            for (int i = 0; i < constant.length; i++) {
954                int val = constant[i];
955                if (val < 0 || val >= constant.length) {
956                    return False;
957                }
958                if (partialOrdering[constant[i]] != null) {
959                    // TODO
960                    return new IrSortStringsChannel(fstrings, fints, TrueFalseDomain);
961                }
962                partialOrdering[constant[i]] = fstrings[i];
963            }
964            return sortStrict(partialOrdering);
965        }
966        return new IrSortStringsChannel(fstrings, fints, TrueFalseDomain);
967    }

969    public static IrBoolExpr allDifferent(IrIntExpr[] ints) {
970        if (ints.length < 2) {
971            return True;
972        }
973        if (ints.length == 2) {
974            return notEqual(ints[0], ints[1]);
975        }
976        Domain domain = ints[0].getDomain();
977        int size = ints[0].getDomain().size();
978        for (int i = 1; i < ints.length; i++) {
979            domain = domain.union(ints[i].getDomain());
980            size += ints[i].getDomain().size();
981            if (size != domain.size()) {
982                return new IrAllDifferent(ints, TrueFalseDomain);
983            }
984        }
985        return True;
986    }

988    public static IrBoolExpr selectN(IrBoolExpr[] bools, IrIntExpr n) {
989        if (bools.length == 1) {
990            if (bools[0].equals(n)) {
991                return True;
992            }
993        }
994        if (n.getDomain().getLowBound() > bools.length
995                || n.getDomain().getHighBound() < 0) {
996            return False;
997        }
998        boolean entailed = true;
999        Domain nDomain = n.getDomain();
1000        for (int i = 0; i < bools.length; i++) {
1001            if (bools[i].getDomain().isTrue()) {
1002                if (i >= nDomain.getHighBound()) {
1003                    return False;
1004                }
1005                if (i >= nDomain.getLowBound()) {
1006                    entailed = false;
1007                }
1008            } else if (bools[i].getDomain().isFalse()) {
1009                if (i < nDomain.getLowBound()) {
1010                    return False;
1011                }
1012                if (i < nDomain.getHighBound()) {
1013                    entailed = false;
1014                }
1015            } else {
1016                entailed = false;
1017            }
1018        }
1019        if (entailed
1020                && n.getDomain().getLowBound() >= 0
1021                && n.getDomain().getHighBound() <= bools.length) {
1022            return True;
1023        }
1024        if (n.isConstant()) {
1025            int constant = n.getLowBound();
1026            IrBoolExpr[] ands = new IrBoolExpr[bools.length];
1027            System.arraycopy(bools, 0, ands, 0, constant);
1028            for (int i = constant; i < bools.length; i++) {
1029                ands[i] = not(bools[i]);
1030            }
1031            return and(ands);
1032        }
1033        return new IrSelectN(bools, n, TrueFalseDomain);
1034    }

1120            return constant(-expr.getLowBound());
1121        }
1122        if (expr instanceof IrMinus) {
1123            IrMinus minus = (IrMinus) expr;
1124            return minus.getExpr();
1125        }
1126        return new IrMinus(expr, expr.getDomain().minus());

1130    public static IrIntExpr card(IrSetExpr set) {
1131        if (set instanceof IrSetVar) {
1132            IrSetVar var = (IrSetVar) set;
1133            return var.getCardVar();
1134        } else if (set instanceof IrJoinFunction) {
1135            IrJoinFunction join = (IrJoinFunction) set;
1136            if (join.hasGlobalCardinality() && join.getGlobalCardinality().equals(1)) {
1137                return card(join.getTake());
1138            }
1139        } else if (set instanceof IrSetUnion) {
1140            IrSetUnion union = (IrSetUnion) set;
1141            if (union.isDisjoint()) {
1142                IrSetExpr[] operands = union.getOperands();
1143                IrIntExpr[] cards = new IrIntExpr[operands.length];
1144                for (int i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
1145                    cards[i] = card(operands[i]);
1146                }
1147                return add(cards);
1148            }
1149        } else if (set instanceof IrOffset) {
1150            IrOffset offset = (IrOffset) set;
1151            return card(offset.getSet());
1152        } else if (set instanceof IrSetTernary) {
1153            IrSetTernary ternary = (IrSetTernary) set;
1154            return ternary(ternary.getAntecedent(),
1155                    card(ternary.getConsequent()),
1156                    card(ternary.getAlternative()));
1157        }
1158        Domain domain = set.getCard();
1159        if (domain.isConstant()) {
1160            return constant(domain.getLowBound());
1161        }
1162        return new IrCard(set, domain);
1163    }

1183    public static IrIntExpr add(IrIntExpr... addends) {
1184        int constants = 0;
1185        List<IrIntExpr> filter = new ArrayList<>(addends.length);
1186        for (IrIntExpr addend : addends) {
1187            if (addend instanceof IrAdd) {
1188                IrAdd add = (IrAdd) addend;
1189                // Invariant: No nested IrAdd or constants
1190                filter.addAll(Arrays.asList(add.getAddends()));
1191                constants += add.getOffset();
1192            } else {
1193                if (addend.isConstant()) {
1194                    constants += addend.getLowBound();
1195                } else {
1196                    filter.add(addend);
1197                }
1198            }
1199        }
1200        if (filter.isEmpty()) {
1201            return constant(constants);
1202        }
1203        if (filter.size() == 1) {
1204            IrIntExpr first = filter.get(0);
1205            if (constants == 0) {
1206                return first;
1207            }
1208            return new IrAdd(new IrIntExpr[]{first}, constants,
1209                    first.getDomain().offset(constants));
1210        }
1211        Domain domain = filter.stream().map(IrIntExpr::getDomain).reduce(
1212                constantDomain(constants), Domain::add);
1213        return new IrAdd(filter.toArray(new IrIntExpr[filter.size()]), constants, domain);
1214    }

1260    private static int mulTwo(int a, int b) {
1261        long ma = a;
1262        long mb = b;
1263        long mul = ma * mb;
1264        // A Domain cannot have Integer.MAX_VALUE as its high bound (it stores high + 1).
1265        if (mul >= Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
1266            return Integer.MAX_VALUE - 1;
1267        } else if (mul < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
1268            return Integer.MIN_VALUE;
1269        }
1270        return (int) mul;
1271    }

1277    public static IrIntExpr mul(IrIntExpr multiplicand, IrIntExpr multiplier, Domain intRange) {
1278        if (multiplicand.isConstant()) {
1279            switch (multiplicand.getLowBound()) {
1280                case -1:
1281                    return minus(multiplier);
1282                case 0:
1283                    return multiplicand;
1284                case 1:
1285                    return multiplier;
1286            }
1287        }
1288        if (multiplier.isConstant()) {
1289            switch (multiplier.getLowBound()) {
1290                case -1:
1291                    return minus(multiplicand);
1292                case 0:
1293                    return multiplier;
1294                case 1:
1295                    return multiplicand;
1296            }
1297        }
1298        if (multiplicand.isConstant() && multiplier.isConstant()) {
1299            return constant(multiplicand.getLowBound() * multiplier.getLowBound());
1300        }
1301        Domain domain;
1302        long m0 = multiplicand.getDomain().size();
1303        long m1 = multiplier.getDomain().size();
1304        // Enumerate the products of small domains, but not of large ones, e.g.
1305        // a decimal times a constant over the default range of decimals.
1306        if (m0 * m1 <= 16 || (m0 * m1 <= intRange.size() && m0 * m1 <= 1 << 16)) {
1307            TIntSet domainSet = new TIntHashSet();
1308            PrimitiveIterator.OfInt iter0 = multiplicand.getDomain().iterator();
1309            // TODO: implement domain.mul
1310            while (iter0.hasNext()) {
1311                long i0 = iter0.next();
1312                PrimitiveIterator.OfInt iter1 = multiplier.getDomain().iterator();
1313                while (iter1.hasNext()) {
1314                    long i1 = iter1.next();
1315                    long mul = i0 * i1;
1316                    int mulI = (int) mul;
1317                    if (mul == mulI) {
1318                        domainSet.add(mulI);
1319                    }
1320                }
1321            }
1322            domain = enumDomain(domainSet);
1323        } else {
1324            domain = mulBoundDomain(multiplicand.getDomain(), multiplier.getDomain()).intersection(intRange);
1325        }
1326        if (domain.isEmpty()) {
1327            throw new UnsatisfiableException();
1328        }
1329        return new IrMul(multiplicand, multiplier, intRange, domain);
1330    }
1331
1332    public static Domain mulBoundDomain(Domain multiplicandDomain, Domain multiplierDomain) {
1333        int low1 = multiplicandDomain.getLowBound();
1334        int high1 = multiplicandDomain.getHighBound();
1335        int low2 = multiplierDomain.getLowBound();
1336        int high2 = multiplierDomain.getHighBound();
1337        int ll = mulTwo(low1, low2);
1338        int lh = mulTwo(low1, high2);
1339        int hl = mulTwo(high1, low2);
1340        int hh = mulTwo(high1, high2);
1341        return boundDomain(
1342                Util.min(ll, lh, hl, hh),
1343                Util.max(ll, lh, hl, hh));
1344    }

1346    public static IrIntExpr mul(IrIntExpr[] multiplicands, Domain intRange) {
1347        if (multiplicands.length == 0) {
1348            return One;
1349        }
1350        IrIntExpr product = multiplicands[0];
1351        for (int i = 1; i < multiplicands.length; i++) {
1352            product = mul(product, multiplicands[i], intRange);
1353        }
1354        return product;
1355    }

1361    public static IrIntExpr div(IrIntExpr dividend, int divisor) {
1362        if (divisor == 1) {
1363            return dividend;
1364        }
1365        return div(dividend, constant(divisor));
1366    }

1368    public static IrIntExpr div(IrIntExpr dividend, IrIntExpr divisor) {
1369        if (dividend.isConstant() && dividend.getLowBound() == 0) {
1370            return dividend;
1371        }
1372        if (divisor.isConstant() && divisor.getLowBound() == 1) {
1373            return dividend;
1374        }
1375        if (dividend.isConstant() && divisor.isConstant()) {
1376            if (divisor.getLowBound() == 0) {
1377                throw new UnsatisfiableException();
1378            }
1379            return constant(dividend.getLowBound() / divisor.getLowBound());
1380        }
1381        int low = dividend.getDomain().getLowBound();
1382        int high = dividend.getDomain().getHighBound();
1383        int min = Util.min(low, -low, high, -high);
1384        int max = Util.max(low, -low, high, -high);
1385        return new IrDiv(dividend, divisor, boundDomain(min, max));
1386    }

1388    /**
1389     * The largest magnitude of the result of a decimal multiplication or
1390     * division. Choco rejects domains wider than {@code Integer.MAX_VALUE}.
1391     */
1392    private static final long DecimalArithmBound = Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2 - 1;
1393
1394    /**
1395     * Multiplication or division of decimals scaled by {@code one}, rounded
1396     * half away from zero.
1397     *
1398     * @param op multiplication or division
1399     * @param left the multiplicand or dividend
1400     * @param right the multiplier or divisor
1401     * @param one the integer representing the decimal 1
1402     * @param decimalRange the range of decimals, limits the result
1403     * @return {@code round(left * right / one)} or
1404     * {@code round(left * one / right)}
1405     */
1406    public static IrIntExpr decimalArithm(IrDecimalArithm.Op op, IrIntExpr left, IrIntExpr right,
1407            int one, Domain decimalRange) {
1408        boolean mul = op == IrDecimalArithm.Op.Mul;
1409        if (left.isConstant() && right.isConstant()) {
1410            long l = left.getLowBound();
1411            long r = right.getLowBound();
1412            if (!mul && r == 0) {
1413                throw new UnsatisfiableException();
1414            }
1415            long value = mul ? Util.divRound(l * r, one) : Util.divRound(l * one, r);
1416            // Not limited to the range of decimals, see below; e.g. the product of
1417            // the uninitialized reference of a Clafer that does not exist.
1418            return constant((int) Math.max(-DecimalArithmBound, Math.min(DecimalArithmBound, value)));
1419        }
1420        if (right.isConstant() && right.getLowBound() == one) {
1421            return left;
1422        }
1423        if (mul && left.isConstant() && left.getLowBound() == one) {
1424            return right;
1425        }
1426        if (mul && ((left.isConstant() && left.getLowBound() == 0)
1427                || (right.isConstant() && right.getLowBound() == 0))) {
1428            return Zero;
1429        }
1430        long low = Long.MAX_VALUE;
1431        long high = Long.MIN_VALUE;
1432        long[] ls = {left.getLowBound(), left.getHighBound()};
1433        if (mul) {
1434            for (long l : ls) {
1435                for (long r : new long[]{right.getLowBound(), right.getHighBound()}) {
1436                    long value = Util.divRound(l * r, one);
1437                    low = Math.min(low, value);
1438                    high = Math.max(high, value);
1439                }
1440            }
1441        } else {
1442            // The divisor is not zero: the bounds of each sign of the divisor.
1443            List<long[]> parts = new ArrayList<>(2);
1444            if (right.getLowBound() < 0) {
1445                parts.add(new long[]{right.getLowBound(), Math.min(right.getHighBound(), -1)});
1446            }
1447            if (right.getHighBound() > 0) {
1448                parts.add(new long[]{Math.max(right.getLowBound(), 1), right.getHighBound()});
1449            }
1450            if (parts.isEmpty()) {
1451                throw new UnsatisfiableException();
1452            }
1453            for (long[] part : parts) {
1454                for (long l : ls) {
1455                    for (long r : part) {
1456                        long value = Util.divRound(l * one, r);
1457                        low = Math.min(low, value);
1458                        high = Math.max(high, value);
1459                    }
1460                }
1461            }
1462        }
1463        // The result is not limited to the range of decimals: an operand can be
1464        // the uninitialized reference of a Clafer that does not exist, e.g. in
1465        // [ all i : Item | i.dref * 1.5 <= 30 ], and the product must not fail
1466        // then. Saturated so that Choco accepts the domain.
1467        low = Math.max(low, -DecimalArithmBound);
1468        high = Math.min(high, DecimalArithmBound);
1469        return new IrDecimalArithm(op, left, right, one, decimalRange, boundDomain((int) low, (int) high));
1470    }

1472    public static IrIntExpr mod(IrIntExpr dividend, IrIntExpr divisor) {
1473        if (dividend.isConstant() && dividend.getLowBound() == 0) {
1474            return dividend;
1475        }
1476        if (dividend.isConstant() && divisor.isConstant()) {
1477            if (divisor.getLowBound() == 0) {
1478                throw new UnsatisfiableException();
1479            }
1480            return constant(dividend.getLowBound() % divisor.getLowBound());
1481        }
1482        int low = divisor.getDomain().getLowBound();
1483        int high = divisor.getDomain().getHighBound();
1484        int min = Math.min(-Math.abs(low), -Math.abs(high));
1485        int max = Math.max(Math.abs(low), Math.abs(high));
1486        return new IrMod(dividend, divisor, boundDomain(min, max));
1487    }

1497            return get($array, index.getLowBound());

1499            return ternary((IrBoolExpr) index, get($array, 1), get($array, 0));
1500        }
1501
1502        Optional<Domain> domain = Util.mapWithin(
1503                index.getDomain().stream(), $array.getDomains())

1509    public static IrIntExpr count(int value, IrIntArrayExpr array) {
1510        List<IrIntExpr> filter = new ArrayList<>();
1511        int count = 0;
1512        for (IrIntExpr i : IrUtil.asArray(array)) {
1513            if (i.equals(constant(value))) {
1514                count++;
1515            } else if (i.getDomain().contains(value)) {
1516                filter.add(i);
1517            }
1518        }
1519        switch (filter.size()) {
1520            case 0:
1521                return constant(count);
1522            case 1:
1523                return add(equal(value, filter.get(0)), count);
1524            default:
1525                return add(
1526                        new IrCount(value,
1527                                array.length() == filter.size() ? array : intArray(filter),
1528                                boundDomain(0, filter.size())),
1529                        count);
1530        }
1531    }

1537    public static IrIntExpr max(IrSetExpr set, int defaultValue) {
1538        if (set.getCard().getHighBound() == 0) {
1539            return constant(defaultValue);
1540        }
1541        if (set instanceof IrSingleton) {
1542            IrSingleton singleton = (IrSingleton) set;
1543            return singleton.getValue();
1544        }
1545        Domain domain = set.getEnv();
1546        if (!set.getKer().isEmpty()) {
1547            domain = domain.boundLow(set.getKer().getHighBound());
1548        }
1549        return IrUtil.asConstant(new IrSetMax(set, defaultValue, set.getCard().getLowBound() > 0
1550                ? domain : domain.insert(defaultValue)));
1551    }

1553    public static IrIntExpr min(IrSetExpr set, int defaultValue) {
1554        if (set.getCard().getHighBound() == 0) {
1555            return constant(defaultValue);
1556        }
1557        if (set instanceof IrSingleton) {
1558            IrSingleton singleton = (IrSingleton) set;
1559            return singleton.getValue();
1560        }
1561        Domain domain = set.getEnv();
1562        if (!set.getKer().isEmpty()) {
1563            domain = domain.boundHigh(set.getKer().getLowBound());
1564        }
1565        return IrUtil.asConstant(new IrSetMin(set, defaultValue, set.getCard().getLowBound() > 0
1566                ? domain : domain.insert(defaultValue)));
1567    }

1569    public static IrIntExpr sum(IrSetExpr set) {
1570        if (set.getCard().getHighBound() == 0) {
1571            return Zero;
1572        }
1573        if (set.getCard().getHighBound() == 1) {
1574            return min(set, 0);
1575        }
1576        if (set instanceof IrSingleton) {
1577            IrSingleton singleton = (IrSingleton) set;
1578            return singleton.getValue();
1579        }
1580
1581        int sum = set.getKer().stream().sum();
1582        int count = set.getKer().size();
1583
1584        // Calculate low
1585        int low = sum;
1586        int lowCount = count;
1587        PrimitiveIterator.OfInt envIter = set.getEnv().iterator();
1588        while (lowCount < set.getCard().getHighBound() && envIter.hasNext()) {
1589            int env = envIter.next();
1590            if (env >= 0 && lowCount >= set.getCard().getLowBound()) {
1591                break;
1592            }
1593            if (!set.getKer().contains(env)) {
1594                low += env;
1595                lowCount++;
1596            }
1597        }
1598
1599        // Calculate high
1600        int high = sum;
1601        int highCount = count;
1602        envIter = set.getEnv().iterator(false);
1603        while (highCount < set.getCard().getHighBound() && envIter.hasNext()) {
1604            int env = envIter.next();
1605            if (env <= 0 && highCount >= set.getCard().getLowBound()) {
1606                break;
1607            }
1608            if (!set.getKer().contains(env)) {
1609                high += env;
1610                highCount++;
1611            }
1612        }
1613
1614        return new IrSetSum(set, boundDomain(low, high));
1615    }

1617    public static IrIntExpr ternary(IrBoolExpr antecedent, IrIntExpr consequent, IrIntExpr alternative) {
1618        if (antecedent.getDomain().isTrue()) {
1619            return consequent;
1620        }
1621        if (antecedent.getDomain().isFalse()) {
1622            return alternative;
1623        }
1624        if (consequent.equals(alternative)) {
1625            return consequent;
1626        }
1627        Domain domain = consequent.getDomain().union(alternative.getDomain());
1628        return new IrTernary(antecedent, consequent, alternative, domain);
1629    }

1727    public static IrSetExpr arrayToSet(IrIntExpr[] array, Integer globalCardinality) {
1728        switch (array.length) {
1729            case 0:
1730                return EmptySet;
1731            case 1:
1732                return singleton(array[0]);
1733            default:
1734                Domain env = array[0].getDomain();
1735                for (int i = 1; i < array.length; i++) {
1736                    env = env.union(array[i].getDomain());
1737                }
1738                TIntSet values = new TIntHashSet();
1739                for (IrIntExpr i : array) {
1740                    if (i.isConstant()) {
1741                        values.add(i.getLowBound());
1742                    }
1743                }
1744                Domain ker = enumDomain(values);
1745                int lowCard = Math.max(
1746                        globalCardinality == null ? 1 : divRoundUp(array.length, globalCardinality),
1747                        ker.size());
1748                int highCard = Math.min(array.length, env.size());
1749                if (lowCard > highCard) {
1750                    assert globalCardinality > 0;
1751                    throw new UnsatisfiableException();
1752                }
1753                Domain card = boundDomain(lowCard, highCard);
1754                return IrUtil.asConstant(new IrArrayToSet(array, env, ker, card, globalCardinality));
1755        }
1756    }

1758    public static IrSetExpr element(IrSetArrayExpr array, IrIntExpr index) {
1759        if (index.isConstant()) {
1760            return get(array, index.getLowBound());
1761        } else if (index instanceof IrBoolExpr) {
1762            return ternary((IrBoolExpr) index, get(array, 1), get(array, 0));
1763        }
1764
1765        // TODO bound for other element calls
1766        PrimitiveIterator.OfInt iter = index.getDomain().boundBetween(0, array.length() - 1).iterator();
1767        assert iter.hasNext();
1768
1769        int val = iter.next();
1770        Domain env = array.getEnvs()[val];
1771        Domain ker = array.getKers()[val];
1772        Domain card = array.getCards()[val];
1773        while (iter.hasNext()) {
1774            val = iter.next();
1775            env = env.union(array.getEnvs()[val]);
1776            ker = ker.intersection(array.getKers()[val]);
1777            card = card.union(array.getCards()[val]);
1778        }
1779        return IrUtil.asConstant(new IrSetElement(array, index, env, ker, card));
1780    }

1782    /**
1783     * Relational join.
1784     *
1785     * Union{for all i in take} children[i]
1786     *
1787     * @param take
1788     * @param children
1789     * @param injective
1790     * @return the join expression take.children
1791     */
1792    public static IrSetExpr joinRelation(IrSetExpr take, IrSetArrayExpr children, boolean injective) {
1793        Domain takeEnv = take.getEnv();
1794        Domain takeKer = take.getKer();
1795        Domain takeCard = take.getCard();
1796
1797        if (takeEnv.isEmpty()) {
1798            return EmptySet;
1799        }
1800        IrSetArrayExpr $children = subArray(children, 0, takeEnv.getHighBound() + 1);
1801
1802        IrIntExpr[] ints = IrUtil.asInts(children);
1803        if (ints != null) {
1804            return joinFunction(take, ints, injective ? 1 : null);
1805        }
1806
1807        if (take.isConstant()) {
1808            int[] array = takeKer.getValues();
1809            IrSetExpr[] to = new IrSetExpr[array.length];
1810            for (int i = 0; i < to.length; i++) {
1811                // TODO optimize
1812                to[i] = get($children, array[i]);
1813            }
1814            return union(to, injective);
1815        }
1816
1817        if (take instanceof IrSingleton) {
1818            IrSingleton singleton = (IrSingleton) take;
1819            return element(children, singleton.getValue());
1820        }
1821
1822        // Compute env
1823        Domain env = Util.map(
1824                takeEnv.stream(), $children.getEnvs())
1825                .reduce(Domain::union).orElse(EmptyDomain);
1826
1827        // Compute ker
1828        Domain ker = Util.map(
1829                takeKer.stream(), $children.getKers())
1830                .reduce(Domain::union).orElse(EmptyDomain);
1831
1832        // Compute card
1833        int index = 0;
1834        int[] childrenLowCards = new int[takeEnv.size() - takeKer.size()];
1835        int[] childrenHighCards = new int[takeEnv.size() - takeKer.size()];
1836        int cardLow = 0, cardHigh = 0;
1837
1838        PrimitiveIterator.OfInt iter = takeEnv.iterator();
1839        while (iter.hasNext()) {
1840            int val = iter.next();
1841            Domain childDomain = $children.getCards()[val];
1842            if (takeKer.contains(val)) {
1843                cardLow = injective
1844                        ? cardLow + childDomain.getLowBound()
1845                        : Math.max(cardLow, childDomain.getLowBound());
1846                cardHigh += childDomain.getHighBound();
1847            } else {
1848                childrenLowCards[index] = childDomain.getLowBound();
1849                childrenHighCards[index] = childDomain.getHighBound();
1850                index++;
1851            }
1852        }
1853        assert index == childrenLowCards.length;
1854        assert index == childrenHighCards.length;
1855
1856        Arrays.sort(childrenLowCards);
1857        Arrays.sort(childrenHighCards);
1858
1859        for (int i = 0; i < takeCard.getLowBound() - takeKer.size(); i++) {
1860            cardLow = injective
1861                    ? cardLow + childrenLowCards[i]
1862                    : Math.max(cardLow, childrenLowCards[i]);
1863        }
1864        for (int i = 0; i < takeCard.getHighBound() - takeKer.size(); i++) {
1865            cardHigh += childrenHighCards[childrenHighCards.length - 1 - i];
1866        }
1867        cardLow = Math.max(cardLow, ker.size());
1868        cardHigh = Math.min(cardHigh, env.size());
1869        Domain card = boundDomain(cardLow, cardHigh);
1870
1871        return IrUtil.asConstant(new IrJoinRelation(take, $children, env, ker, card, injective));
1872    }

1878    private static boolean isIdentityRelation(IrIntArrayExpr refs) {
1879        for (int i = 0; i < refs.length(); i++) {
1880            Domain domain = refs.getDomains()[i];
1881            if (!domain.isConstant() || domain.getLowBound() != i) {
1882                return false;
1883            }
1884        }
1885        return true;
1886    }

1888    public static IrSetExpr joinFunction(IrSetExpr take, IrIntArrayExpr refs, Integer globalCardinality) {
1889        Domain takeEnv = take.getEnv();
1890        Domain takeKer = take.getKer();
1891        Domain takeCard = take.getCard();
1892
1893        if (takeEnv.isEmpty()) {
1894            return EmptySet;
1895        }
1896        IrIntArrayExpr $refs = subArray(refs, 0, takeEnv.getHighBound() + 1);
1897
1898        if (take.isConstant()) {
1899            int[] array = takeKer.getValues();
1900            IrIntExpr[] to = new IrIntExpr[array.length];
1901            for (int i = 0; i < to.length; i++) {
1902                to[i] = get($refs, array[i]);
1903            }
1904            return arrayToSet(to, globalCardinality);
1905        }
1906
1907        if (isIdentityRelation($refs)) {
1908            return take;
1909        }
1910
1911        if (take instanceof IrSingleton) {
1912            IrSingleton singleton = (IrSingleton) take;
1913            return singleton(element(refs, singleton.getValue()));
1914        }
1915
1916        // Compute env
1917        Domain env = Util.map(
1918                takeEnv.stream(), refs.getDomains())
1919                .reduce(Domain::union).orElse(EmptyDomain);
1920
1921        // Compute ker
1922        Domain ker = Util.map(
1923                takeKer.stream(), refs.getDomains())
1924                .filter(Domain::isConstant).reduce(Domain::union).orElse(EmptyDomain);
1925
1926        // Compute card
1927        int lowTakeCard = takeCard.getLowBound();
1928        int highTakeCard = takeCard.getHighBound();
1929        Domain card;
1930        if (globalCardinality == null) {
1931            card = lowTakeCard == 0
1932                    ? boundDomain(Math.max(0, ker.size()), Math.min(highTakeCard, env.size()))
1933                    : boundDomain(Math.max(1, ker.size()), Math.min(highTakeCard, env.size()));
1934        } else {
1935            card = boundDomain(
1936                    divRoundUp(Math.max(lowTakeCard, ker.size()), globalCardinality),
1937                    Math.min(highTakeCard, env.size()));
1938        }
1939
1940        return IrUtil.asConstant(new IrJoinFunction(take, $refs, env, ker, card, globalCardinality));
1941    }
1942
1943    private static int divRoundUp(int a, int b) {
1944        assert a >= 0;
1945        assert b > 0;
1946
1947        return (a + b - 1) / b;
1948    }

1950    public static IrSetExpr difference(IrSetExpr minuend, IrSetExpr subtrahend) {
1951        Domain env = minuend.getEnv().difference(subtrahend.getKer());
1952        Domain ker = minuend.getKer().difference(subtrahend.getEnv());
1953        int low = Math.max(0, minuend.getCard().getLowBound() - subtrahend.getCard().getHighBound());
1954        int high = minuend.getCard().getHighBound();
1955        Domain card = boundDomain(Math.max(low, ker.size()), Math.min(high, env.size()));
1956        return new IrSetDifference(minuend, subtrahend, env, ker, card);
1957    }

1959    public static IrSetExpr intersection(IrSetExpr... operands) {
1960        List<IrSetExpr> flatten = new ArrayList<>(operands.length);
1961        for (IrSetExpr operand : operands) {
1962            if (operand instanceof IrSetIntersection) {
1963                // Invariant: No nested IrSetIntersection
1964                flatten.addAll(Arrays.asList(((IrSetIntersection) operand).getOperands()));
1965            } else {
1966                flatten.add(operand);
1967            }
1968        }
1969        Domain constants = null;
1970        List<IrSetExpr> filter = new ArrayList<>();
1971        for (IrSetExpr operand : flatten) {
1972            if (operand.isConstant()) {
1973                if (constants == null) {
1974                    constants = operand.getKer();
1975                } else {
1976                    constants = constants.intersection(operand.getKer());
1977                }
1978            } else {
1979                filter.add(operand);
1980            }
1981        }
1982        if (constants != null) {
1983            filter.add(constant(constants));
1984        }
1985        IrSetExpr[] ops = filter.toArray(new IrSetExpr[filter.size()]);
1986        switch (ops.length) {
1987            case 0:
1988                return EmptySet;
1989            case 1:
1990                return ops[0];
1991            default:
1992                Domain env = ops[0].getEnv();
1993                Domain ker = ops[0].getKer();
1994                int low = 0;
1995                int high = ops[0].getCard().getHighBound();
1996                for (int i = 1; i < ops.length; i++) {
1997                    env = env.intersection(ops[i].getEnv());
1998                    ker = ker.intersection(ops[i].getKer());
1999                    high = Math.max(high, ops[i].getCard().getHighBound());
2000                }
2001                Domain card = boundDomain(
2002                        Math.max(low, ker.size()),
2003                        Math.min(high, env.size()));
2004                return new IrSetIntersection(ops, env, ker, card);
2005        }
2006    }

2008    public static IrSetExpr union(IrSetExpr... operands) {
2009        return union(operands, false);
2010    }

2012    public static IrSetExpr unionDisjoint(IrSetExpr... operands) {

2016    public static IrSetExpr union(IrSetExpr[] operands, boolean disjoint) {
2017        List<IrSetExpr> flatten = new ArrayList<>(operands.length);
2018        for (IrSetExpr operand : operands) {
2019            if (operand instanceof IrSetUnion) {
2020                // Invariant: No nested IrSetUnion
2021                flatten.addAll(Arrays.asList(((IrSetUnion) operand).getOperands()));
2022            } else {
2023                flatten.add(operand);
2024            }
2025        }
2026        Domain constants = Domains.EmptyDomain;
2027        List<IrSetExpr> filter = new ArrayList<>();
2028        for (IrSetExpr operand : flatten) {
2029            if (operand.isConstant()) {
2030                constants = constants.union(operand.getKer());
2031            } else {
2032                filter.add(operand);
2033            }
2034        }
2035        if (!constants.isEmpty()) {
2036            filter.add(constant(constants));
2037        }
2038        IrSetExpr[] ops = filter.toArray(new IrSetExpr[filter.size()]);
2039        switch (ops.length) {
2040            case 0:
2041                return EmptySet;
2042            case 1:
2043                return ops[0];
2044            default:
2045                Domain env = ops[0].getEnv();
2046                Domain ker = ops[0].getKer();
2047                Domain operandCard = ops[0].getCard();
2048                int low = operandCard.getLowBound();
2049                int high = operandCard.getHighBound();
2050                for (int i = 1; i < ops.length; i++) {
2051                    env = env.union(ops[i].getEnv());
2052                    ker = ker.union(ops[i].getKer());
2053                    operandCard = ops[i].getCard();
2054                    low = disjoint
2055                            ? low + operandCard.getLowBound()
2056                            : Math.max(low, operandCard.getLowBound());
2057                    high += operandCard.getHighBound();
2058                }
2059                int cardLow = Math.max(low, ker.size());
2060                int cardHigh = Math.min(high, env.size());
2061                if (cardLow > cardHigh) {
2062                    throw new IllegalSetException();
2063                }
2064                Domain card = boundDomain(cardLow, cardHigh);
2065                return IrUtil.asConstant(new IrSetUnion(ops, env, ker, card, disjoint));
2066        }
2067    }

2069    public static IrSetExpr offset(IrSetExpr set, int offset) {
2070        if (offset == 0) {
2071            return set;
2072        }
2073        if (set instanceof IrOffset) {
2074            IrOffset nested = (IrOffset) set;
2075            return offset(nested.getSet(), offset + nested.getOffset());
2076        }
2077        Domain env = set.getEnv().offset(offset);
2078        Domain ker = set.getKer().offset(offset);
2079        Domain card = set.getCard();
2080        return IrUtil.asConstant(new IrOffset(set, offset, env, ker, card));
2081    }

2083    public static IrSetExpr mask(IrSetExpr set, int from, int to) {
2084        if (from > to) {
2085            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
2086        }
2087        if (from == to || set.getEnv().isEmpty()) {
2088            return EmptySet;
2089        }
2090        if (from <= set.getEnv().getLowBound() && to > set.getEnv().getHighBound()) {
2091            return offset(set, -from);
2092        }
2093        Domain env = set.getEnv().offset(-from).boundBetween(0, to - from - 1);
2094        Domain ker = set.getKer().offset(-from).boundBetween(0, to - from - 1);
2095        Domain card = boundDomain(ker.size(), Math.min(env.size(), set.getCard().getHighBound()));
2096        return IrUtil.asConstant(new IrMask(set, from, to, env, ker, card));
2097    }

2099    public static IrSetExpr ternary(IrBoolExpr antecedent, IrSetExpr consequent, IrSetExpr alternative) {
2100        if (antecedent.getDomain().isTrue()) {
2101            return consequent;
2102        }
2103        if (antecedent.getDomain().isFalse()) {
2104            return alternative;
2105        }
2106        if (consequent.equals(alternative)) {
2107            return consequent;
2108        }
2109        Domain env = consequent.getEnv().union(alternative.getEnv());
2110        Domain ker = consequent.getKer().intersection(alternative.getKer());
2111        Domain card = consequent.getCard().union(alternative.getCard());
2112        return new IrSetTernary(antecedent, consequent, alternative, env, ker, card);
2113    }

2115    public static IrSetExpr containsTernary(IrSetExpr antecedent, int x, IrSetExpr consequent) {
2116        if (antecedent.getKer().contains(x)) {
2117            return consequent;
2118        }
2119        if (!antecedent.getEnv().contains(x)) {
2120            return EmptySet;
2121        }
2122        return new IrContainsSetTernary(antecedent, x, consequent, consequent.getEnv(), EmptyDomain, consequent.getCard().insert(0));
2123    }

2249    public static IrSetArrayExpr inverse(IrSetArrayExpr relation, int length) {
2250        TIntSet[] envs = new TIntSet[length];
2251        TIntSet[] kers = new TIntSet[length];
2252        for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
2253            envs[i] = new TIntHashSet();
2254            kers[i] = new TIntHashSet();
2255        }
2256        for (int i = 0; i < relation.length(); i++) {
2257            PrimitiveIterator.OfInt iter = relation.getEnvs()[i].iterator();
2258            while (iter.hasNext()) {
2259                int val = iter.next();
2260                if (val < envs.length) {
2261                    envs[val].add(i);
2262                }
2263            }
2264            iter = relation.getKers()[i].iterator();
2265            while (iter.hasNext()) {
2266                int val = iter.next();
2267                if (val < kers.length) {
2268                    kers[val].add(i);
2269                }
2270            }
2271        }
2272        Domain[] cards = new Domain[length];
2273        for (int i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
2274            cards[i] = boundDomain(kers[i].size(), envs[i].size());
2275        }
2276        return new IrInverse(relation, enumDomains(envs), enumDomains(kers), cards);
2277    }

2279    public static IrSetArrayExpr transitiveClosure(IrSetArrayExpr relation, boolean reflexive) {
2280        int n = relation.length();
2281        Domain[] envs = new Domain[n];
2282        Domain[] kers = new Domain[n];
2283        Domain[] cards = new Domain[n];
2284
2285        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
2286            TIntSet env = reachable(relation.getEnvs(), i, reflexive);
2287            TIntSet ker = reachable(relation.getKers(), i, reflexive);
2288            envs[i] = enumDomain(env);
2289            kers[i] = enumDomain(ker);
2290            cards[i] = boundDomain(kers[i].size(), envs[i].size());
2291        }
2292        return new IrTransitiveClosure(relation, reflexive, envs, kers, cards);
2293    }
2294
2295    /**
2296     * The nodes reachable from the node in one or more steps of the relation, and the node
2297     * itself if reflexive. A node is visited when it is first reached, so the search continues
2298     * past the direct successors (gsdlab/chocosolver#47).
2299     */
2300    private static TIntSet reachable(Domain[] relation, int from, boolean reflexive) {
2301        TIntSet reached = new TIntHashSet();
2302        if (reflexive) {
2303            reached.add(from);
2304        }
2305        TIntStack q = new TIntArrayStack(relation.length);
2306        q.push(from);
2307        while (q.size() > 0) {
2308            int node = q.pop();
2309            if (node < relation.length) {
2310                relation[node].stream().filter(reached::add).forEach(q::push);
2311            }
2312        }
2313        return reached;
2314    }

2323    public static final IrStringVar EmptyString = new IrStringVar("", new IrIntVar[0], Zero);
2324
2325    public static IrStringVar constant(String value) {
2326        if (value.length() == 0) {
2327            return EmptyString;
2328        }
2329        IrIntVar[] chars = new IrIntVar[value.length()];
2330        for (int i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) {
2331            chars[i] = constant(value.charAt(i));
2332        }
2333        IrIntVar length = constant(value.length());
2334        return new IrStringVar(value, chars, length);
2335    }
2336
2337    public static IrStringVar string(String name, IrIntVar[] chars, IrIntVar length) {
2338        if (length.isConstant()) {
2339            char[] string = new char[chars.length];
2340            for (int i = 0; string != null && i < string.length; i++) {
2341                if (chars[i].isConstant()) {
2342                    string[i] = (char) chars[i].getLowBound();
2343                } else {
2344                    string = null;
2345                }
2346            }
2347            if (string != null) {
2348                return constant(new String(string, 0, length.getLowBound()));
2349            }
2350        }
2351        int lengthHigh = length.getDomain().getHighBound();
2352        if (lengthHigh < 0) {
2353            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
2354        }
2355        int maxLength = chars.length - 1;
2356        while (maxLength >= lengthHigh && Zero.equals(chars[maxLength])) {
2357            maxLength--;
2358        }
2359        if (maxLength + 1 < chars.length) {
2360            chars = Arrays.copyOf(chars, maxLength + 1);
2361        }
2362        return new IrStringVar(name, chars, length);
2363    }

2365    public static IrStringVar string(String name, Domain charDomain, int maxLength) {
2366        Domain domain = charDomain.insert(0);
2367        IrIntVar[] chars = new IrIntVar[maxLength];
2368        for (int i = 0; i < maxLength; i++) {
2369            chars[i] = domainInt(name + "[" + i + "]", domain);
2370        }
2371        return string(name, chars, boundInt("|" + name + "|", 0, maxLength));
2372    }
2373
2374    public static IrStringExpr element(IrStringExpr[] array, IrIntExpr index) {
2375        IrStringExpr[] $array = index.getDomain().getHighBound() + 1 < array.length
2376                ? Arrays.copyOf(array, index.getDomain().getHighBound() + 1)
2377                : array.clone();
2378        for (int i = 0; i < $array.length; i++) {
2379            if (!index.getDomain().contains(i)) {
2380                $array[i] = EmptyString;
2381            }
2382        }
2383
2384        if (index.isConstant()) {
2385            return $array[index.getLowBound()];
2386        }
2387        PrimitiveIterator.OfInt iter = index.getDomain().iterator();
2388        assert iter.hasNext();
2389
2390        Domain length = EmptyDomain;
2391        Domain[] chars = new Domain[IrUtil.maxLength($array)];
2392        Arrays.fill(chars, EmptyDomain);
2393        while (iter.hasNext()) {
2394            int val = iter.next();
2395            if (val < $array.length) {
2396                IrStringExpr string = $array[val];
2397                length = length.union(string.getLength());
2398                for (int i = 0; i < string.getChars().length; i++) {
2399                    chars[i] = chars[i].union(string.getChars()[i]);
2400                }
2401            }
2402        }
2403        for (int i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) {
2404            if (i < length.getLowBound()) {
2405                chars[i] = chars[i].remove(0);
2406            } else {
2407                assert i < length.getHighBound();
2408                chars[i] = chars[i].insert(0);
2409            }
2410        }
2411        return new IrStringElement($array, index, chars, length);
2412    }
2413
2414    public static IrStringExpr concat(IrStringExpr left, IrStringExpr right) {
2415        Domain leftLength = left.getLength();
2416        Domain[] leftChars = left.getChars();
2417        Domain rightLength = right.getLength();
2418        Domain[] rightChars = right.getChars();
2419
2420        if (leftLength.getHighBound() == 0) {
2421            return right;
2422        }
2423        if (rightLength.getHighBound() == 0) {
2424            return left;
2425        }
2426
2427        Domain length;
2428        if (leftLength.isConstant()) {
2429            length = rightLength.offset(leftLength.getLowBound());
2430        } else if (rightLength.isConstant()) {
2431            length = leftLength.offset(rightLength.getLowBound());
2432        } else {
2433            length = boundDomain(
2434                    leftLength.getLowBound() + rightLength.getLowBound(),
2435                    leftLength.getHighBound() + rightLength.getHighBound());
2436        }
2437        Domain[] charDomains = new Domain[length.getHighBound()];
2438        int i;
2439        for (i = 0; i < leftLength.getLowBound(); i++) {
2440            charDomains[i] = leftChars[i];
2441        }
2442        Domain union = EmptyDomain;
2443        for (; i < leftLength.getHighBound(); i++) {
2444            int j = i - leftLength.getLowBound();
2445            if (j < rightChars.length) {
2446                union = union.union(rightChars[j]);
2447            }
2448            charDomains[i] = leftChars[i].union(union);
2449        }
2450        for (; i < charDomains.length; i++) {
2451            int j = i - leftLength.getLowBound();
2452            int k = i - leftLength.getHighBound();
2453            assert k < rightChars.length;
2454            charDomains[i] = union(rightChars, k, Math.min(j + 1, rightChars.length));
2455        }
2456        for (i = length.getLowBound(); i < charDomains.length; i++) {
2457            charDomains[i] = charDomains[i].insert(0);
2458        }
2459        return IrUtil.asConstant(new IrConcat(left, right, charDomains, length));
2460    }

2462    public static IrIntArrayExpr subarray(IrIntArrayExpr array, IrIntExpr index, IrIntExpr sublength) {
2463        if (index.isConstant()) {
2464            if (sublength.isConstant()) {
2465                IrIntExpr[] subarray = new IrIntExpr[array.length()];
2466                for (int i = 0; i < sublength.getLowBound(); i++) {
2467                    int j = index.getLowBound() + i;
2468                    // Past the end of the array is padding, as in Constraints.subarray.
2469                    subarray[i] = j < array.length() ? get(array, j) : constant(-1);
2470                }
2471                for (int i = sublength.getLowBound(); i < subarray.length; i++) {
2472                    subarray[i] = constant(-1);
2473                }
2474                return array(subarray);
2475            }
2476        }
2477        Domain[] charDomains = new Domain[array.length()];
2478        for (int i = 0; i < charDomains.length; i++) {
2479            charDomains[i] = i < sublength.getHighBound() && index.getLowBound() + i < charDomains.length
2480                    ? union(array.getDomains(),
2481                            index.getLowBound() + i,
2482                            Integer.min(index.getHighBound() + i + 1, charDomains.length))
2483                    : NegativeOneDomain;
2484            if (i >= sublength.getLowBound()) {
2485                charDomains[i] = charDomains[i].insert(-1);
2486            }
2487        }
2488        return new IrSubarray(array, index, sublength, charDomains);
2489    }
2490
2491    private static Domain union(Domain[] domains, int start, int end) {
2492        assert start < end;
2493        Domain union = domains[start];
2494        for (int i = start + 1; i < end; i++) {
2495            union = union.union(domains[i]);
2496        }
2497        return union;
2498    }
